open_release.rationale: The paper motivates synthetic EHR as a substitute for EHR that cannot be publicly released, and evaluates privacy attacks.

quotes.text: Such circumstances limit the public release of rich EHR data, hence impeding the advancement of precision medicine methodologies.
To mitigate the issue of limited publicly available EHR data, researchers alternatively explored generating synthetic EHR data

pipeline_testing.rationale: No test-data or development-data framing in the paper or README.

ml_augmentation.rationale: Downstream classifiers are trained on synthetic EHR and tested on real data.

quotes.text: The downstream biomedical models can benefit from training on synthetic EHR data by EHRDiff , potentially overcoming the obstacles of limited publicly available real EHR data.

statistical_replication.rationale: Code prevalence and pairwise correlation (CMD) against real data are evaluated.

quotes.text: CMD results demonstrate that EHRDiff can better capture the inherent pair-wise relations between code features than GAN-based methods.

causal_inference.rationale: No causal or DAG framing in the paper or README.

education.rationale: No teaching or demonstration framing in the paper or README.

benchmarking.rationale: EHRDiff is the proposed method compared against GAN baselines, not used as a baseline or benchmark in these sources.

imbalance_correction.rationale: Rare codes are discussed only as a mode-collapse check, with no minority-class oversampling.
